bubble.alt: A bubble lit from the right against black, its surface marbled with swirling bands.
bubble.caption: A bubble of soap film, half lit. The marbling is the film draining. (The photographer mixed oil into the soap.)

film.alt: Round islands with concentric rings floating in a dark soap film.
film.caption: Soap film under a microscope: islands of thicker film in a thinning sheet.
film.credit: Karl Gaff, "Lipid Islands on Soap Bubble", via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0). Converted to grayscale.

marbling.alt: Close view of a soap bubble whose surface is covered in fine swirling bands.

froth.alt: A dome-shaped cluster of soap bubbles against black, each outlined by thin bright walls.
froth.caption: Froth: a cluster of bubbles sharing their walls.

black-film.alt: The top of a soap bubble mottled with black patches where the film has thinned.
black-film.caption: Dark patches at the top of a bubble, where the film has thinned so far that it looks black. A film this thin is close to bursting.

thinning.alt: A large dark area of very thin soap film dotted with pale discs, meeting bright banded film along a sharp curved edge.
